mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during triggered months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a 2-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals deteriorating demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both fall for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during triggered months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the industrial production index above 0.5 percent signals stronger supply capacity, which boosts earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during triggered months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5 percent signals a restrictive monetary stance, which raises discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during triggered months (t-test p > 0.05).

failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during triggered months (t-test p > 0.05).
